channel.title: Lila · Notes
channel.description: Quiet writing from Lila about the 72-square Leela board game, its real history, and self-inquiry that stays on your iPhone.

item.title: Reflection without a diary: why your thoughts shouldn't live on a server
item.description: A private journaling alternative built as an on-device board game for iPhone: no account, no server, App Privacy label Data Not Collected, and why a finite game beats an infinite feed for honest self-review.

item.title: The 72-square board: what Leela actually is
item.description: The Leela board game before it was Snakes and Ladders: the gyan chauper ancestry, the 72-square reflective tradition of self-knowledge, and what our iPhone adaptation keeps, changes, and openly invents.
